meta.question: on CUB, does averaging the masked teacher over stochastic (Gumbel top-K from the student's lateroll map) masks give a KD target closer to the full teacher than the deterministic top-K, and does the same averaging over uniform random masks stay worse (metric sanity)?
meta.method: attention rollout (blocks 6..11); Gumbel top-K / Plackett-Luce sampling; keep-only masked teacher faithfulness (KL, DKD TCKD) of the averaged distribution; image bootstrap
meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Kool et al. ICML 2019 (Gumbel top-k); Hinton et al. 2015 (KD gradient p_s - p_t); Zhao et al. CVPR 2022 (DKD); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD)
